title: X-LAB RT9 frameset specification
notes: Official mainland RT9 frameset page for a climbing road frame: the frameset includes a carbon integrated handlebar (360×80 to 400×120 mm by size) and a 300 mm carbon seatpost; frame weight 550 g for an unpainted size-M frame excluding fork and seatpost; carbon fork with 12×100 mm thru-axle and flat-mount brakes; four sizes XS–L with the same stack/reach table as the international page. The official bicycle listing shows the frameset at CNY 26,800. This page states no carbon grade or maximum tire clearance.
